answer: Submitting an answer locks 33 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. The inlet escrow is released only against a beacon receipt, and the ocean audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 283 aliases means carrying 265 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. That is 13 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
